076        public void apply() {
077                
078                int size = market.getSize();
079                
080                boolean patrol = getSpec().hasTag(Industries.TAG_PATROL);
081                boolean militaryBase = getSpec().hasTag(Industries.TAG_MILITARY);
082                boolean command = getSpec().hasTag(Industries.TAG_COMMAND);
083                
084                super.apply(!patrol);
085                if (patrol) {
086                        applyIncomeAndUpkeep(3);
087                }
088                
089                int extraDemand = 0;
090                
091                int light = 1;
092                int medium = 0;
093                int heavy = 0;
094                
095                if (patrol) {
096                        extraDemand = 0;
097                } else if (militaryBase) {
098                        extraDemand = 2;
099                } else if (command) {
100                        extraDemand = 3;
101                }
102                
103                if (patrol) {
104                        light = 2;
105                        medium = 0;
106                        heavy = 0;
107                } else {
108                        if (size <= 3) {
109                                light = 2;
110                                medium = 0;
111                                heavy = 0;
112                        } else if (size == 4) {
113                                light = 2;
114                                medium = 0;
115                                heavy = 0;
116                        } else if (size == 5) {
117                                light = 2;
118                                medium = 1;
119                                heavy = 0;
120                        } else if (size == 6) {
121                                light = 3;
122                                medium = 1;
123                                heavy = 0;
124                        } else if (size == 7) {
125                                light = 3;
126                                medium = 2;
127                                heavy = 0;
128                        } else if (size == 8) {
129                                light = 3;
130                                medium = 3;
131                                heavy = 0;
132                        } else if (size >= 9) {
133                                light = 4;
134                                medium = 3;
135                                heavy = 0;
136                        }
137                }
138                
139                if (militaryBase || command) {
140                        //light++;
141                        medium = Math.max(medium + 1, size / 2 - 1);
142                        heavy = Math.max(heavy, medium - 1);
143                }
144                
145                if (command) {
146                        medium++;
147                        heavy++;
148                }
149                
150//              if (market.getId().equals("jangala")) {
151//                      System.out.println("wefwefwe");
152//              }
153                
154//              light += 5;
155//              medium += 3;
156//              heavy += 2;
157                
158//              float spawnRateMultStability = getStabilitySpawnRateMult();
159//              if (spawnRateMultStability != 1) {
160//                      market.getStats().getDynamic().getStat(Stats.COMBAT_FLEET_SPAWN_RATE_MULT).modifyMult(getModId(), spawnRateMultStability);
161//              }
162                
163                
164                market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.PATROL_NUM_LIGHT_MOD).modifyFlat(getModId(), light);
165                market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.PATROL_NUM_MEDIUM_MOD).modifyFlat(getModId(), medium);
166                market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.PATROL_NUM_HEAVY_MOD).modifyFlat(getModId(), heavy);
167                
168                
169                demand(Commodities.SUPPLIES, size - 1 + extraDemand);
170                demand(Commodities.FUEL, size - 1 + extraDemand);
171                demand(Commodities.SHIPS, size - 1 + extraDemand);
172                
173                supply(Commodities.CREW, size);
174                
175                if (!patrol) {
176                        //demand(Commodities.HAND_WEAPONS, size);
177                        supply(Commodities.MARINES, size);
178                        
179//                      Pair<String, Integer> deficit = getMaxDeficit(Commodities.HAND_WEAPONS);
180//                      applyDeficitToProduction(1, deficit, Commodities.MARINES);
181                }
182                
183                
184                modifyStabilityWithBaseMod();
185                
186                float mult = getDeficitMult(Commodities.SUPPLIES);
187                String extra = "";
188                if (mult != 1) {
189                        String com = getMaxDeficit(Commodities.SUPPLIES).one;
190                        extra = " (" + getDeficitText(com).toLowerCase() + ")";
191                }
192                float bonus = DEFENSE_BONUS_MILITARY;
193                if (patrol) bonus = DEFENSE_BONUS_PATROL;
194                else if (command) bonus = DEFENSE_BONUS_COMMAND;
195                market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.GROUND_DEFENSES_MOD)
196                                                .modifyMult(getModId(), 1f + bonus * mult, getNameForModifier() + extra);
197                
198                
199                MemoryAPI memory = market.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
200                Misc.setFlagWithReason(memory, MemFlags.MARKET_PATROL, getModId(), true, -1);
201                
202                if (militaryBase || command) {
203                        Misc.setFlagWithReason(memory, MemFlags.MARKET_MILITARY, getModId(), true, -1);
204                }
205                
206                float officerProb = OFFICER_PROB_MOD_PATROL_HQ;
207                if (militaryBase) officerProb = OFFICER_PROB_MOD_MILITARY_BASE;
208                else if (command) officerProb = OFFICER_PROB_MOD_HIGH_COMMAND;
209                market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.OFFICER_PROB_MOD).modifyFlat(getModId(0), officerProb);
210                
211                
212                if (!isFunctional()) {
213                        supply.clear();
214                        unapply();
215                }
216                
217                if (market.isPlayerOwned()) {
218                        if (isFunctional()) {
219                                addPersonnelOfficer();
220                                addBaseCommander();
221                        } else {
222                                removePersonnelOfficer();
223                                removeBaseCommander();
224                        }
225                }
226
227        }

229        @Override
230        public void unapply() {
231                super.unapply();
232                
233                MemoryAPI memory = market.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
234                Misc.setFlagWithReason(memory, MemFlags.MARKET_PATROL, getModId(), false, -1);
235                Misc.setFlagWithReason(memory, MemFlags.MARKET_MILITARY, getModId(), false, -1);
236                
237                unmodifyStabilityWithBaseMod();
238                
239                //market.getStats().getDynamic().getStat(Stats.COMBAT_FLEET_SPAWN_RATE_MULT).unmodifyMult(getModId());
240                //market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.GROUND_DEFENSES_MULT).unmodifyFlat(getModId());
241                
242                market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.PATROL_NUM_LIGHT_MOD).unmodifyFlat(getModId());
243                market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.PATROL_NUM_MEDIUM_MOD).unmodifyFlat(getModId());
244                market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.PATROL_NUM_HEAVY_MOD).unmodifyFlat(getModId());
245                
246                market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.GROUND_DEFENSES_MOD).unmodifyMult(getModId());
247                
248                market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.OFFICER_PROB_MOD).unmodifyFlat(getModId(0));
249                
250                if (market.isPlayerOwned()) {
251                        removePersonnelOfficer();
252                        removeBaseCommander();
253                }
254        }

345        public boolean isAvailableToBuild() {
346                boolean canBuild = false;
347                for (Industry ind : market.getIndustries()) {
348                        if (ind == this) continue;
349                        if (!ind.isFunctional()) continue;
350                        if (ind.getSpec().hasTag(Industries.TAG_SPACEPORT)) {
351                                canBuild = true;
352                                break;
353                        }
354                }
355                return canBuild;
356        }

364        protected IntervalUtil tracker = new IntervalUtil(Global.getSettings().getFloat("averagePatrolSpawnInterval") * 0.7f,

384        @Override
385        public void advance(float amount) {
386                super.advance(amount);
387                
388                if (Global.getSector().getEconomy().isSimMode()) return;
389
390                if (!isFunctional()) return;
391                
392                float days = Global.getSector().getClock().convertToDays(amount);
393                
394//              float stability = market.getPrevStability();
395//              float spawnRate = 1f + (stability - 5) * 0.2f;
396//              if (spawnRate < 0.5f) spawnRate = 0.5f;
397                
398                sinceReturn += days;
399                if (sinceReturn < PATROL_NO_SPAWN_AFTER_RETURN_TIMEOUT_DAYS) return;
400                
401                float spawnRate = 1f;
402                float rateMult = market.getStats().getDynamic().getStat(Stats.COMBAT_FLEET_SPAWN_RATE_MULT).getModifiedValue();
403                spawnRate *= rateMult;
404                
405                if (Global.getSector().isInNewGameAdvance()) {
406                        spawnRate *= 3f;
407                }
408                
409                float extraTime = 0f;
410                if (returningPatrolValue > 0) {
411                        // apply "returned patrols" to spawn rate, at a maximum rate of 1 interval per day
412                        float interval = tracker.getIntervalDuration();
413                        extraTime = interval * days;
414                        returningPatrolValue -= days;
415                        if (returningPatrolValue < 0) returningPatrolValue = 0;
416                }
417                tracker.advance(days * spawnRate + extraTime);
418                
419                //DebugFlags.FAST_PATROL_SPAWN = true;
420                if (DebugFlags.FAST_PATROL_SPAWN) {
421                        tracker.advance(days * spawnRate * 100f);
422                }
423                
424                if (tracker.intervalElapsed()) {
425//                      if (market.isPlayerOwned()) {
426//                              System.out.println("ewfwefew");
427//                      }
428//                      if (market.getName().equals("Jangala")) {
429//                              System.out.println("wefwefe");
430//                      }
431                        String sid = getRouteSourceId();
432                        
433                        int light = getCount(PatrolType.FAST);
434                        int medium = getCount(PatrolType.COMBAT);
435                        int heavy = getCount(PatrolType.HEAVY);
436
437                        int maxLight = getMaxPatrols(PatrolType.FAST);
438                        int maxMedium = getMaxPatrols(PatrolType.COMBAT);
439                        int maxHeavy = getMaxPatrols(PatrolType.HEAVY);
440                        
441                        WeightedRandomPicker<PatrolType> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<PatrolType>();
442                        picker.add(PatrolType.HEAVY, maxHeavy - heavy); 
443                        picker.add(PatrolType.COMBAT, maxMedium - medium); 
444                        picker.add(PatrolType.FAST, maxLight - light); 
445                        
446                        if (picker.isEmpty()) return;
447                        
448                        PatrolType type = picker.pick();
449                        PatrolFleetData custom = new PatrolFleetData(type);
450                        
451                        OptionalFleetData extra = new OptionalFleetData(market);
452                        extra.fleetType = type.getFleetType();
453                        
454                        RouteData route = RouteManager.getInstance().addRoute(sid, market, Misc.genRandomSeed(), extra, this, custom);
455                        extra.strength = (float) getPatrolCombatFP(type, route.getRandom());
456                        extra.strength = Misc.getAdjustedStrength(extra.strength, market);
457                        
458                        
459                        float patrolDays = 35f + (float) Math.random() * 10f;
460                        route.addSegment(new RouteSegment(patrolDays, market.getPrimaryEntity()));
461                }
462        }

487        public int getCount(PatrolType ... types) {
488                int count = 0;
489                for (RouteData data : RouteManager.getInstance().getRoutesForSource(getRouteSourceId())) {
490                        if (data.getCustom() instanceof PatrolFleetData) {
491                                PatrolFleetData custom = (PatrolFleetData) data.getCustom();
492                                for (PatrolType type : types) {
493                                        if (type == custom.type) {
494                                                count++;
495                                                break;
496                                        }
497                                }
498                        }
499                }
500                return count;
501        }

503        public int getMaxPatrols(PatrolType type) {
504                if (type == PatrolType.FAST) {
505                        return (int) market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.PATROL_NUM_LIGHT_MOD).computeEffective(0);
506                }
507                if (type == PatrolType.COMBAT) {
508                        return (int) market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.PATROL_NUM_MEDIUM_MOD).computeEffective(0);
509                }
510                if (type == PatrolType.HEAVY) {
511                        return (int) market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.PATROL_NUM_HEAVY_MOD).computeEffective(0);
512                }
513                return 0;
514        }

529        public void reportFleetDespawnedToListener(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, FleetDespawnReason reason, Object param) {
530                if (!isFunctional()) return;
531                
532                if (reason == FleetDespawnReason.REACHED_DESTINATION) {
533                        RouteData route = RouteManager.getInstance().getRoute(getRouteSourceId(), fleet);
534                        if (route.getCustom() instanceof PatrolFleetData) {
535                                PatrolFleetData custom = (PatrolFleetData) route.getCustom();
536                                if (custom.spawnFP > 0) {
537                                        float fraction  = fleet.getFleetPoints() / custom.spawnFP;
538                                        returningPatrolValue += fraction;
539                                        sinceReturn = 0f;
540                                }
541                        }
542                }
543        }
544        
545        public static int getPatrolCombatFP(PatrolType type, Random random) {
546                float combat = 0;
547                switch (type) {
548                case FAST:
549                        combat = Math.round(3f + (float) random.nextFloat() * 2f) * 5f;
550                        break;
551                case COMBAT:
552                        combat = Math.round(6f + (float) random.nextFloat() * 3f) * 5f;
553                        break;
554                case HEAVY:
555                        combat = Math.round(10f + (float) random.nextFloat() * 5f) * 5f;
556                        break;
557                }
558                return (int) Math.round(combat);
559        }
560        
561        public CampaignFleetAPI spawnFleet(RouteData route) {
562                
563                PatrolFleetData custom = (PatrolFleetData) route.getCustom();
564                PatrolType type = custom.type;
565                
566                Random random = route.getRandom();
567                
568                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = createPatrol(type, market.getFactionId(), route, market, null, random);
569                
570                if (fleet == null || fleet.isEmpty()) return null;
571                
572                fleet.addEventListener(this);
573                
574                market.getContainingLocation().addEntity(fleet);
575                fleet.setFacing((float) Math.random() * 360f);
576                // this will get overridden by the patrol assignment AI, depending on route-time elapsed etc
577                fleet.setLocation(market.getPrimaryEntity().getLocation().x, market.getPrimaryEntity().getLocation().y);
578                
579                fleet.addScript(new PatrolAssignmentAIV4(fleet, route));
580                
581                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.FLEET_IGNORES_OTHER_FLEETS, true, PATROL_IGNORE_OTHER_FLEETS_DELAY_DAYS);
582                fleet.getStats().addTemporaryModMult(PATROL_IGNORE_OTHER_FLEETS_DELAY_DAYS, "preparingForPatrol", "Preparing for patrol duty", 0f, 
583                                fleet.getStats().getSensorRangeMod());
584                
585                //market.getContainingLocation().addEntity(fleet);
586                //fleet.setLocation(market.getPrimaryEntity().getLocation().x, market.getPrimaryEntity().getLocation().y);
587                
588                if (custom.spawnFP <= 0) {
589                        custom.spawnFP = fleet.getFleetPoints();
590                }
591                
592                return fleet;
593        }

596                return createPatrol(type, 0f, factionId, route, market, locInHyper, random);
597        }
598        public static CampaignFleetAPI createPatrol(PatrolType type, float extraTankerPts, String factionId, RouteData route, MarketAPI market, Vector2f locInHyper, Random random) {
599                if (random == null) random = new Random();
600                
601                
602                float combat = getPatrolCombatFP(type, random);
603                float tanker = 0f;
604                float freighter = 0f;
605                String fleetType = type.getFleetType();
606                switch (type) {
607                case FAST:
608                        break;
609                case COMBAT:
610                        tanker = Math.round((float) random.nextFloat() * 5f);
611                        break;
612                case HEAVY:
613                        tanker = Math.round((float) random.nextFloat() * 10f);
614                        freighter = Math.round((float) random.nextFloat() * 10f);
615                        break;
616                }
617                
618                tanker += extraTankerPts;
619                
620                FleetParamsV3 params = new FleetParamsV3(
621                                market, 
622                                locInHyper,
623                                factionId,
624                                route == null ? null : route.getQualityOverride(),
625                                fleetType,
626                                combat, // combatPts
627                                freighter, // freighterPts 
628                                tanker, // tankerPts
629                                0f, // transportPts
630                                0f, // linerPts
631                                0f, // utilityPts
632                                0f // qualityMod
633                                );
634                if (route != null) {
635                        params.timestamp = route.getTimestamp();
636                }
637                params.random = random;
638                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = FleetFactoryV3.createFleet(params);
639                
640                if (fleet == null || fleet.isEmpty()) return null;
641                
642                if (!fleet.getFaction().getCustomBoolean(Factions.CUSTOM_PATROLS_HAVE_NO_PATROL_MEMORY_KEY)) {
643                        fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_PATROL_FLEET, true);
644                        if (type == PatrolType.FAST || type == PatrolType.COMBAT) {
645                                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_CUSTOMS_INSPECTOR, true);
646                        }
647                } else if (fleet.getFaction().getCustomBoolean(Factions.CUSTOM_PIRATE_BEHAVIOR)) {
648                        fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_PIRATE, true);
649                        
650                        // hidden pather and pirate bases
651                        // make them raid so there's some consequence to just having a colony in a system with one of those
652                        if (market != null && market.isHidden()) {
653                                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_RAIDER, true);
654                        }
655                }
656                
657                String postId = Ranks.POST_PATROL_COMMANDER;
658                String rankId = Ranks.SPACE_COMMANDER;
659                switch (type) {
660                case FAST:
661                        rankId = Ranks.SPACE_LIEUTENANT;
662                        break;
663                case COMBAT:
664                        rankId = Ranks.SPACE_COMMANDER;
665                        break;
666                case HEAVY:
667                        rankId = Ranks.SPACE_CAPTAIN;
668                        break;
669                }
670                
671                fleet.getCommander().setPostId(postId);
672                fleet.getCommander().setRankId(rankId);
673                
674                return fleet;
675        }

696        protected void addAlphaCoreDescription(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, AICoreDescriptionMode mode) {
697                float opad = 10f;
698                Color highlight = Misc.getHighlightColor();
699                
700                String pre = "Alpha-level AI core currently assigned. ";
701                if (mode == AICoreDescriptionMode.MANAGE_CORE_DIALOG_LIST || mode == AICoreDescriptionMode.INDUSTRY_TOOLTIP) {
702                        pre = "Alpha-level AI core. ";
703                }
704                float a = ALPHA_CORE_BONUS;
705                //String str = "" + (int)Math.round(a * 100f) + "%";
706                String str = Strings.X + (1f + a);
707                
708                if (mode == AICoreDescriptionMode.INDUSTRY_TOOLTIP) {
709                        CommoditySpecAPI coreSpec = Global.getSettings().getCommoditySpec(aiCoreId);
710                        TooltipMakerAPI text = tooltip.beginImageWithText(coreSpec.getIconName(), 48);
711                        text.addPara(pre + "Reduces upkeep cost by %s. Reduces demand by %s unit. " +
712                                        "Increases fleet size by %s.", 0f, highlight,
713                                        "" + (int)((1f - UPKEEP_MULT) * 100f) + "%", "" + DEMAND_REDUCTION,
714                                        str);
715                        tooltip.addImageWithText(opad);
716                        return;
717                }
718                
719                tooltip.addPara(pre + "Reduces upkeep cost by %s. Reduces demand by %s unit. " +
720                                "Increases fleet size by %s.", opad, highlight,
721                                "" + (int)((1f - UPKEEP_MULT) * 100f) + "%", "" + DEMAND_REDUCTION,
722                                str);
723                
724        }

783        public void addPersonnelOfficer() {
784                PersonAPI person = null;
785                
786                if (saved != null) {
787                        person = saved;
788                } else {
789                        person = market.getFaction().createRandomPerson(StarSystemGenerator.random);
790                        person.setRankId(Ranks.SPACE_CAPTAIN);
791                        person.setPostId(Ranks.POST_PERSONNEL_OFFICER);
792                        
793                        person.setImportanceAndVoice(PersonImportance.MEDIUM, StarSystemGenerator.random);
794                        person.addTag(Tags.CONTACT_MILITARY);
795                        
796                }
797                
798                List<OfficerManagerEvent> listeners = Global.getSector().getListenerManager().getListeners(OfficerManagerEvent.class);
799                if (!listeners.isEmpty()) {
800                        person.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$ome_eventRef", listeners.get(0));
801                }
802                
803                removePersonnelOfficer();
804                
805                if (market.getCommDirectory().getEntryForPerson(person) == null) {
806                        market.getCommDirectory().addPerson(person);
807                }
808                if (!market.getPeopleCopy().contains(person)) {
809                        market.addPerson(person);
810                }
811                
812                saved = person;
813                
814                ImportantPeopleAPI ip = Global.getSector().getImportantPeople();
815                if (!ip.containsPerson(person)) {
816                        ip.addPerson(person);
817                        ip.getData(person).getLocation().setMarket(market);
818                        ip.checkOutPerson(person, "permanent_staff");
819                }
820        }

822        public void removePersonnelOfficer() {
823                PersonAPI officer = null;
824                ImportantPeopleAPI ip = Global.getSector().getImportantPeople();
825                
826                for (PersonAPI person : market.getPeopleCopy()) {
827                        if (Ranks.POST_PERSONNEL_OFFICER.equals(person.getPostId())) {
828                                market.removePerson(person);
829                                market.getCommDirectory().removePerson(person);
830                                ip.removePerson(person);
831                                if (officer == null) officer = person;
832                        }
833                }
834
835                if (officer != null) {
836                        saved = officer;
837                }
838                //return null;
839        }
